verdict.rationale: Superhuman for Teams shares read statuses across the team, shows when teammates are replying to avoid collisions, and lets users @mention teammates and share live email views through team comments, which gives a team a shared view of conversation state on threads. There is no evidence of a true shared inbox: no multi-user access to one shared account (e.g. support@) and no team channels where everyone works the same queue. Missing for 10: documented shared inbox or shared-account access, team channels or a shared queue, assignment or ownership of shared conversations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
